name: Manufacturing GDP · year on year
description: It measures the change in real output for Singapore’s manufacturing sector compared with the same quarter a year earlier. The current figure differs from the first in 6 of 6 comparable quarters. Across those 6 quarters the absolute change averaged about 3.37 percentage points and reached 5.0 percentage points at most.
